prompt:
Edit input 1, paint_mask_guide.png, as a precise-object-edit texture projection atlas. Input 2 design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference; input 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta).
Output ONE PNG, genuine transparent alpha background, 1536x2048 3:4 canvas. Preserve input 1's exact three-column FOUR-row layout of 512x512 cells, exact object positions, sizes, outlines, orientations and gaps. Paint grey objects only, never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them. Rows 1-2 and 3-4 duplicate the same five orthographic views: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Preserve the guide views even though some are tiny end-on crossguard views and some narrow edge-on horizontal swords. Row 2 column 3 and row 4 column 3 stay completely transparent.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of exact MM9 Imperial Sword from references, MM6-MM8-style late-1990s inventory realism. Broad pale-steel blade with gentle asymmetry and swept cutting edge; thin yellow-gold crossguard PERFECTLY HORIZONTAL relative to upright blade, perpendicular to blade and symmetric left/right. Dark brown leather spiral wrapped grip and compact dark-and-gold pommel. Guard-to-pommel is 22-25% of total length; follow existing guide geometry. Preserve details and material divisions from approved master scaled to each view. No blade fuller, ornate guard, jewels, excessive gold, added details. Unlit albedo only: no lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, ground, outlines, text, frame.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: corresponding five unchanged silhouettes filled ONLY with flat pure material category colours, absolutely NO shading, texture, outlines, gradients, antialiased colour blends inside. #FF0000 pure red for ALL metal including entire steel blade, gold guard and gold pommel bands. #00FF00 pure green for all leather including wrapped grip and dark leather pommel portion. #0000FF pure blue for cloth/cord/hair if any, #FFFF00 pure yellow for matte wood/bone/horn/stone/paper/wax if any, #000000 pure black for gem/glass/enamel/liquid if any. Every silhouette pixel gets exactly one category. Do not invent materials. Outside silhouettes is transparent, never black backdrop or checkerboard pixels. Keep all ten objects' registration with guide exactly. The single sword wording in the appearance reference describes the object only: output the full ten-view atlas, never a single sword image.
CRITICAL silhouette correction: use the original grey guide as a strict stencil. The previous attempt produced ragged noisy edges and thickened horizontal blade views. Keep every boundary clean, matching the original guide EXACTLY; do not introduce protrusions, speckles, edge noise or broadening. Edge-on blades must remain the original thin straight silhouettes. Material masks must be clean solid fills right to their stencil edges.
